Founded in 2013–2014 under Traveazy DMCC, the company focuses on helping travel businesses build scalable booking platforms, manage global travel inventory, and create customized travel experiences.

about_short_description.short_description: HolidayMe travel technology and leisure travel platform.

product.name: Dynamic Packaging Platform
product.description: A platform that enables creation of personalized travel packages by combining flights, hotels, transfers, and activities with real-time pricing and inventory management.

product.name: Hotel Distribution Platform
product.description: A platform providing access to over 1 million hotels worldwide with options for API integration, white-label branding, and direct contracts with major hotel chains.

product.name: Umrah-as-a-Service
product.description: A comprehensive Umrah booking platform that manages pilgrim services including hotel bookings near holy sites, visa processing, Haramain train tickets, and guided tours.

product.name: DMC Solutions
product.description: An integrated travel technology platform for Destination Management Companies to manage tours, hotels, activities, payments, and customer data efficiently.

product.name: DMO Solutions
product.description: A destination marketing platform for Destination Marketing Organizations to create campaigns, manage content, analyze visitor data, and distribute destination offerings globally.

product.name: Airline Solutions
product.description: A platform for airlines to integrate flights with hotels, activities, and transfers, enabling dynamic packaging and ancillary revenue growth.
